bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,message_id FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE message_thread_id=1695 AND chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893) AND state='published' AND message_id>0" | docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),https=require("https");const token=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE?fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;let raw="";process.stdin.on("data",x=>raw+=x);process.stdin.on("end",async()=>{const [chat,thread,msg]=raw.trim().split("|").map(Number);if(thread!==1695||!Number.isSafeInteger(msg)||msg<1)process.exit(71);const body=JSON.stringify({chat_id:chat,message_id:msg,disable_notification:true});const req=https.request({hostname:"api.telegram.org",path:"/bot"+token+"/pinChatMessage",method:"POST",family:4,timeout:15000,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Content-Length":Buffer.byteLength(body)}},res=>{let s="";res.on("data",x=>s+=x);res.on("end",()=>{let d={};try{d=JSON.parse(s)}catch{}const t=String(d.description||"").toLowerCase();const c=t.includes("message to pin not found")?"MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND":t.includes("not enough rights")?"RIGHTS":t.includes("message is not modified")?"UNCHANGED":t.includes("message not found")?"MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND":t.includes("chat not found")?"CHAT_NOT_FOUND":t.includes("message can'\''t be pinned")?"NOT_PINNABLE":"OTHER";console.log("PIN_1695_RESULT="+(d.ok?"PASS":c)+" HTTP="+res.statusCode+" TG="+(d.error_code||0));process.exit(d.ok?0:75)})});req.on("error",()=>process.exit(76));req.end(body)});' ; printf 'ROOM_ROUTE_ROWS\n'; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,purpose,enabled,verified_at IS NOT NULL FROM posting_topics WHERE (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=116) OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1605) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=4) ORDER BY chat_id,purpose"
